title: Settings
description: V5 (VS Code-native rows, Managed page) with nested sub-pages to make hundreds of settings less overwhelming. Category pages with several subsections become an overview of subsections (title, count, a preview of the settings inside, modified/managed counts, and the section's on/off switch where it has one); clicking one opens a nested page with just those settings. A breadcrumb in the header (with a back button, Alt+← and mouse back) shows where you are, the sidebar lists only top-level categories, and pages slide in/out with a short transition (fade for category switches; off with reduced motion).
